import subprocess

# Test 1: Cyclic list with cache=True - should return self-referential result
code = r'''
from boltons.iterutils import remap

a = [1]
a.append(a)
result = remap(a, cache=True)
print("Result type:", type(result))
print("Result[0]:", result[0])
print("Result[1] is result:", result[1] is result)
print("PASS: No RecursionError with cache=True")
'''
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', code], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
print(result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-300:])
